correctness.rationale: For a product of exactly three finite fields with q_i>=3, Badawi annihilator adjacency yields six independent support classes of weights (x2*x3,x1*x3,x1*x2,x3,x2,x1), xi=q_i-1>=2, whose quotient is a triangular prism. At most one white per false-twin class; all classes retain a blue when at most one white. Independent direct enumeration of the 2^6 white-type patterns gives profile counts (1,6,15,20,12,0,0) for sizes 0..6; precisely bad 4-types 1256,1346,2345, each weighted product P^2. This proves polynomial (e4-3P^2)u^(N-4)+e3 u^(N-3)+e2 u^(N-2)+N u^(N-1)+u^N; quotient adjacency rank 4 and general M<=Z give real mr=4. Reconstruct xi by N=s1+s2, c2=s1*s2+s1*s3+s2, c4=s3(c2-3s3). Since xi>=2, s3 is the smaller root of 3t^2-c2t+c4; s1 is the smaller root of t^2-(N+s3-1)t+(c2-N); the cubic t^3-s1*t^2+s2*t-s3 has roots xi with multiplicity. An independent 216-triple exact integer test for xi=2..7 confirmed all coefficient identities and both root selections. The unrestricted argument is the exact six-type and algebraic derivation, not this bounded test.

originality.rationale: Badawi and Afkhami et al. already established the annihilator graph and arbitrary-3-field six-class prism decomposition. Wang 2026 generic modular compression also reduces twin profiles. The accepted remainder consists of this weighted exact forcing census and especially the polynomial-to-unordered-three-field-orders inverse theorem, not a claim that support decomposition/twin reduction itself is new.
residual_risks: The full Wang 2026 generic compressed-forcing manuscript was not independently read; a previously unrecognized stronger ring specialization may exist.
The six-class forcing enumeration itself is small; the mathematical value and novelty rest materially on its unequal-weight inverse field-size result.
The theorem excludes binary field factors q_i=2, where singleton support classes invalidate a blue-representative proof.

value.rationale: A complete weighted zero forcing polynomial plus recovery of the entire finite semisimple ring is a motivated inverse combinatorial classification. For products of arbitrary field orders at least three, the polynomial certifies not just a scalar rank but all field orders, an exact natural invariant researchers can use in ring-graph identification. Merely listing the 64 profiles would be modest; inverse reconstruction makes the result substantive.
